A '''Neural whip''' was a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gegak]]. Gegak used it on subordinates who he was not pleased with. The [[Whip (weapon)|whip]] caused immense pain to whoever was struck with it.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
